question: Can the product-eliminated oracle and lazy symbolic setup reduce complete query instruction work drastically beyond v1 while preserving exact answers?

claims.text: All native/profile answers and original witness order match across all arms, with separate polynomial-arithmetic checks.
On both uniform cells require >=5x oracle instruction reduction against v1 with eager setup fixed and >=2x complete cold-process reduction for projected-lazy versus v1-eager; retain all other cells.
Native runtime, external-best, population and scaling results are not established.

arms.description: original-eager on the identical single-query input
original-lazy on the identical single-query input
v1-eager on the identical single-query input
v1-lazy on the identical single-query input
projected-eager on the identical single-query input
projected-lazy on the identical single-query input
original-eager-aa on the identical single-query input

positive.not_applicable_reason: Planted and cancellation queries embedded in every arm; largest-class planted-1 pilot must Found/replay.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Both uniform cells have independent necessary-system inconsistency proofs in the unchanged65-case workload; embedded across all arms, no structural-population claim.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: Single executable, common field/group modules; retained original/v1 decomposition sources and current projected path. Explicit eager/lazy context factor. Same calibrated Valgrind dump markers on all arms.

factors.name: instances
factors.how: Six disclosed prior d12 cases. Identical compact single-query payload on every arm; eight hashes include the two additional positive pilot targets. No old all-workload parser result is used as a new arm.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Rotate seven arms by field/kind/repetition; five rounds.

factors.name: threads
factors.how: Single-threaded native solver; one CPU allocation and2GiB process address-space ceiling for the proposed local exception.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Recorded AMD EPYC9V74 virtual x86 host; CPU0, no PMU; simulated instructions only, no native timing claim.

factors.name: cache_and_layout
factors.how: Fresh native/profile processes per query; no cached factor-base or symbolic setup is free. Eager/lazy setup crossed across all algorithms; all initialization charged.

factors.name: preemption
factors.how: Outer600second total guard, no retries; raw process output and flushed JSONL prefixes retained.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Compiled deterministic summary is hashed before affected data, with no adaptive sample selection or population inference.

seed_derivation.note: Reuse exact fixed prior65-case workload; primary selection explicitly n83/131,d12,distinct-planted-0/uniform/cancellation.

instance_sampling.rule: Reuse exact fixed prior65-case workload; primary selection explicitly n83/131,d12,distinct-planted-0/uniform/cancellation.

blinding.how: Descriptive finite panel only; deterministic Rust summary and decision rules frozen before affected data, arm labels retained for reproducibility. No adaptive interpretation or population test.

power.note: Exact fixed six-cell factorial tabulation with five paired repetitions and A/A; no population p-value or confidence interval.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: 28-call CPU0/2GiB engineering pilot; per field/arm max of positive/uniform times15 primary calls; fixed includes partition calibration/pilot. Resource planning only.

primary.name: Whole cold-process Ir
primary.definition: Sum calibrated setup/oracle/post counter dumps from one complete fresh process, all setup and verification charged.

primary.name: Complete relation-oracle Ir
primary.definition: Client-request partition from before solver call through returned report. Includes base admission, all projection/precompute/search, roots/lifts and internal replay; given context/input construction is separate setup, not silently free.

secondary.name: Setup Ir
secondary.definition: Parsing the same compact Case input, curve/variety construction, eager/lazy symbolic preparation and input point decoding.

secondary.name: Post Ir
secondary.definition: Wrapper replay, serialization, destruction and process exit.

secondary.name: Field multiplies
secondary.definition: Exact sum of setup and oracle/wrapper-replay field ledger; parsing excluded.

secondary.name: Field squares
secondary.definition: Exact field squares including inversion internals, never add informational inversions again.

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed6cases x7arms x5repetitions=210 primary rows; separate28-call pilot and2-call final partition calibration.
Stop on any invalid Found/Refuted result, preserving all rows.
Combined final calibration/pilot/freeze/primary600seconds at CPU0/2GiB, zero retries and paid resources; preserve any failed prefix.

decision_rule.text: Both n83/n131 uniform cells: v1-eager/projected-eager oracle medianIr>=5 and v1-eager/projected-lazy whole medianIr>=2, every210 row valid/exact witness parity and A/A relative median difference<=1%; otherwise partial/inconclusive. Show all cells and full factorial contrasts. No native-time inference.
decision_rule.statistic: Per-cell five-repeat min/median/max, matched factorial ratios and A/A median spread
decision_rule.interval: Exact repeat ranges only; exposed anchors, no population CI
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Ratio of identical-boundary complete cold-process or complete relation-oracle simulated instructions

inadmissible: No timing, scaling, population, full-DLP or challenge-recovery claim.
UNKNOWN is not UNSAT; no row deletion, adaptive seeds or comparison of unpaired favorable subsets.
Native group counters exclude field/ANF, non-group inversions and SAT work; they are not a complete cost unit.

literature.claim: Known S3/Vieta and monic quadratic algebra, with Semaev/Diem references.
Known Artin-Schreier/half-trace identity and existing rational trace-kernel conditions. Product-elimination derivation requires actual residual points and trace-zero u/z.

extensions.authorization: Existing local1CPU/2GiB/600second/zero-paid workflow continues; no new permissions or resources.
extensions.runtime_planning: Max pilot elapsed per field/arm over distinct-planted-1 and uniform, times15 primary calls; add actual fixed calibration/pilot elapsed. Engineering estimate only.
extensions.phase_calibration: Fresh final-binary phased/unphased v1-eager planted-1 call; sum of three dump intervals must agree within0.1%.
extensions.external_comparison_gap: M4RI/FLINT/Magma fastest-external and native-time comparison unestablished.
